title: Dragon in Spotlight Arena
description: A green cartoon dragon with blue eyes and a red scarf sits in the center of a large, cracked metallic disc embedded in muddy ground. A bright beam of light shines down from above, illuminating the dragon amid a dilapidated arena filled with wooden structures, tattered orange banners, and overgrown green vegetation under a dramatic, cloudy sky.
prompt: A vibrant green cartoon dragon with blue eyes, sharp teeth, and a flowing red scarf sits happily in the center of a large circular metallic platform with cracks and orange lines, set in muddy ground with green plants. A strong white spotlight beam shines down from the top right, illuminating the dragon. The background shows a ruined wooden arena with broken structures, wheels, and tattered orange banners hanging from poles, under a dramatic sky with swirling blue, purple, and yellow clouds at dusk.
